annotations.title: Measure a length or an area

description: The map's ruler: geodesic (WGS84 ellipsoid) length of a line in km with each segment and its bearing, or the area (km² and ha) and perimeter of a polygon. Give points as [[lon, lat], ...]; closed=true reads them as a polygon (the first point need not be repeated).

closed.description: true: a polygon (area); false: a line.
